title: Blocking text encoding error
evidence: UnicodeDecodeError: 'utf-8' codec can't decode byte 0xeb in position 399962: invalid continuation byte
reproduction: Parse the frozen Git blob with the inventory builder
recommendation: Resolve or explicitly exclude the invalid source before review

title: Shared SQLite transaction can roll back another session
evidence: Thread B returned success but thread A rollback left zero persisted rows
reproduction: Run two coordinated transactions through one DatabaseConnection in separate threads
recommendation: Use a connection per transaction or context with explicit ownership and savepoints

title: Review audit always attributes actions to web_user
evidence: Workflow calls use the literal actor web_user even when session user is alice
reproduction: Submit review with a mocked workflow and a different current_user
recommendation: Require a server-side authenticated principal and block mutation if absent

title: Schema initialization accepts incomplete or failed databases
evidence: A database with only definities remains incomplete and executescript errors are swallowed
reproduction: Initialize a temporary partial schema and separately raise schema broken from executescript
recommendation: Use atomic versioned migrations and fail startup when required objects are absent

title: Service construction eagerly requires AI credentials
evidence: No-key service initialization fails before an AI flow and one dummy key is insufficient
reproduction: Construct the service with no keys then with only a dummy Anthropic key
recommendation: Create provider clients lazily and inject hermetic clients in tests

title: False-like strings normalize to true
evidence: Values false False 0 and no all normalize to True
reproduction: Call normalize_validation with each false-like string
recommendation: Use one strict boolean parser and reject unknown values fail-closed

title: Smoke tests use the default worktree database
evidence: Running the smoke file created data/definities.db in the execution worktree
reproduction: Run the smoke file from a worktree without that ignored database
recommendation: Use tmp_path fixtures and forbid the default database path in test mode

title: Document context is exposed in prompt debug and download
evidence: AppTest rendered DOCUMENT_SECRET_CASE_123 verbatim and exposed a download button
reproduction: Render a generation result whose prompt contains the sentinel document secret
recommendation: Disable production prompt debug by default and require an audited admin role with redaction

title: Definition text is written verbatim to debug logs
evidence: Cleanup logging includes the first one hundred characters of original and corrected text
reproduction: Trigger a cleanup that changes a sentinel definition and inspect debug output
recommendation: Log only IDs lengths and non-reversible digests

title: Raw internal exception details are shown to users
evidence: A RuntimeError containing a private path and token appeared unchanged in st.error
reproduction: Raise a sentinel exception from workflow or export and capture rendered errors
recommendation: Show generic Dutch microcopy with a correlation ID and log sanitized details server-side

title: Renders above five seconds bypass regression checks
evidence: The timing branch labels every render above five seconds heavy and skips check_regression
reproduction: Invoke metric tracking with render_ms above five thousand and spy on check_regression
recommendation: Classify by operation spans and retain an independent absolute UI watchdog

title: SQLite connections lack deterministic teardown
evidence: The connection provider has no close path and the green pilot emitted unclosed SQLite ResourceWarnings
reproduction: Run all pilot tests with resource warnings enabled
recommendation: Add close and container teardown then gate ResourceWarnings in tests

title: Smoke suite provides weaker evidence than claimed
evidence: The file claims ten tests but collects nine and contains an assertion-free validation test
reproduction: Collect the file and inspect assertions in validation and export cases
recommendation: Define functional smoke criteria and add hermetic behavioral assertions

title: Unused migration shims remain in the service surface
evidence: Base-tree reference search finds no production caller for freeze config and legacy surfaces
reproduction: Search every assigned symbol against the immutable base tree
recommendation: Remove proven dead shims in a separate controlled migration and consolidate contracts

title: Provider reset returns a stale process-cached adapter
evidence: After switching factory target old to new the same adapter returned the old container
reproduction: Populate the singleton cache then switch factory target without clearing SERVICE_ADAPTER_CACHE
recommendation: Remove the redundant cache or invalidate by config version and keep secrets session-scoped

title: Readiness feedback is contradictory
evidence: AppTest showed a missing-context warning followed by a different missing-category error
reproduction: Enter a term without context and activate generation in AppTest
recommendation: Use one readiness model with a disabled CTA and complete missing-requirement feedback

title: Heading hierarchy skips and reverses levels
evidence: Static inspection shows an h3 to h4 jump followed by h3 or subheader headings
reproduction: Render the component and inspect heading levels in source and AppTest
recommendation: Use one semantic heading ladder matching the visual hierarchy
